plainLanguage: Forney is a fast-growing suburb east of Dallas in Kaufman County. We could not confirm its building code edition or zoning numbers in this research pass, so the engine uses typical North Texas defaults and asks you to confirm. Most new Forney homes are in Planned Developments, so your plat and HOA rules usually set the setbacks. The city cannot force a brick percentage, but an HOA can. Expect water, sewer and road impact fees, and an engineer-designed slab for the clay soils.
